item.title: Wrongfully convicted Reggie Dillard gives first TV interview after 27 years behind bars
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. — Reginald "Reggie" Dillard was 30 years old when he was arrested for a murder he says he didn't commit. This week, nearly three decades later, he walked out of the Elkhart County Jail as a free man.

item.title: Two-vehicle crash in Wakarusa after driver drifted over centerline
item.description: ELKHART COUNTY, Ind. -- At approximately 2:48 p.m. a two-vehicle crash occurred near the intersection of C.R. 32 and C.R. 11 in Wakarusa.

item.title: History lives on as Preston Johnson, Sr. is remembered as the first black paramedic for the South Bend Fire Department
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind — Preston Johnson, Sr. is one of Michiana's many trailblazers, creating a path for others to follow in the future.

item.title: Cass Family Clinic invests in workforce training program
item.description: CASSOPOLIS, Mich. -- The Cass Family Clinic is providing workforce training to those who seek a career in healthcare thanks for a grant from Michigan's Department of Health and Human Services and the Department of Labor and Economic Opportunity.

item.title: OMNI Community Credit Union shares impact of 2025 OMNI Gives Back Program
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Ind. -- Through member participation in the 2025 OMNI Gives Back Program, approximately $9,980 was donated to Domestic & Sexual Abuse Services (DSAS) in St. Joseph County to support survivors of domestic and sexual violence.

item.title: Elkhart City Council approves 42-unit affordable housing development
item.description: ELKHART, Ind. -- Thursday night, the Elkhart City Council unanimously approved a new ordinance to support a new 42-unit affordable housing development on Sterling Avenue near Sterling Park.

item.title: Two-vehicle crash on S.R. 2 leaves one dead, crash investigation ongoing
item.description: ST. JOSEPH COUNTY, Ind. -- Crash investigation is currently underway.

item.title: Indiana passes Stadium Bill to Attract Chicago Bears as Illinois works to make plays
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind.— Illinois & Indiana state lawmakers are going head-to-head to attract the Monsters of the Midway.

item.title: City of South Bend hosts 11th Black History Month Awards Ceremony
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Thursday evening, the City of South Bend held the 11th annual Black History Month Awards Ceremony to honor several African American leaders in the community for their contributions to South Bend's rich history and culture.

item.title: Hidalgo leads Notre Dame past Syracuse in home finale
item.description: SOUTH BEND, Ind. -- Notre Dame pulled away late to beat Syracuse 72-62 on Thursday night in Atlantic Coast Conference women’s basketball action at Purcell Pavilion, handing the Orange a tough road loss.
